title: Harden repository baseline and separate high-risk CI tests
description: Remove plaintext credentials from source-controlled configuration, make CI unit-only by default, and prepare a reviewed local Git baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Source-controlled configuration contains placeholders rather than usable credentials.
Push and pull-request CI runs Release build and ERP.UnitTests only.
SQL integration and UI tests are manual jobs protected by GitHub environments and secrets.
A local Git baseline exists without deploy, release, logs, user inputs, bin or obj artifacts.

human_gate.reason: User explicitly requested implementation of the proposed secure automated workflow.
